requirements.quote:
All errors detected while processing the OPEN message MUST be
   indicated by sending the NOTIFICATION message with the Error Code
   OPEN Message Error.  The Error Subcode elaborates on the specific
   nature of the error.
requirements.condition: Any error is detected while processing an OPEN message.
requirements.error_behavior: MUST send a NOTIFICATION message indicating the error.
requirements.why_checkable: The OPEN processing branch and generated NOTIFICATION can be checked with the specified input.

requirements.required_behavior: MUST set its Error Code to OPEN Message Error.
requirements.why_checkable: The OPEN processing branch and generated NOTIFICATION can be checked with the specified input.

requirements.quote:
If the Autonomous System field of the OPEN message is unacceptable,
   then the Error Subcode MUST be set to Bad Peer AS.  The determination
   of acceptable Autonomous System numbers is outside the scope of this
   protocol.
requirements.condition: The Autonomous System field of the received OPEN message is unacceptable.
requirements.required_behavior: MUST set the Error Subcode to Bad Peer AS.
requirements.why_checkable: The OPEN processing branch and generated NOTIFICATION can be checked with the specified input.

requirements.quote:
If the Hold Time field of the OPEN message is unacceptable, then the
   Error Subcode MUST be set to Unacceptable Hold Time.  An
   implementation MUST reject Hold Time values of one or two seconds.
   An implementation MAY reject any proposed Hold Time.  An
   implementation that accepts a Hold Time MUST use the negotiated value
   for the Hold Time.
requirements.condition: The Hold Time field of the received OPEN message is unacceptable.
requirements.required_behavior: MUST set the Error Subcode to Unacceptable Hold Time.
requirements.why_checkable: The OPEN processing branch and generated NOTIFICATION can be checked with the specified input.

requirements.quote:
If the Hold Time field of the OPEN message is unacceptable, then the
   Error Subcode MUST be set to Unacceptable Hold Time.  An
   implementation MUST reject Hold Time values of one or two seconds.
   An implementation MAY reject any proposed Hold Time.  An
   implementation that accepts a Hold Time MUST use the negotiated value
   for the Hold Time.
requirements.condition: The OPEN message proposes a Hold Time of one or two seconds.
requirements.error_behavior: MUST reject the proposed Hold Time.
requirements.why_checkable: The OPEN processing branch and generated NOTIFICATION can be checked with the specified input.

requirements.quote:
If the Hold Time field of the OPEN message is unacceptable, then the
   Error Subcode MUST be set to Unacceptable Hold Time.  An
   implementation MUST reject Hold Time values of one or two seconds.
   An implementation MAY reject any proposed Hold Time.  An
   implementation that accepts a Hold Time MUST use the negotiated value
   for the Hold Time.
requirements.condition: An OPEN message proposes any Hold Time.
requirements.required_behavior: MAY reject any proposed Hold Time.
requirements.why_checkable: The acceptance policy can reject proposed values beyond the mandatory one- and two-second rejection cases.

requirements.quote:
If the Hold Time field of the OPEN message is unacceptable, then the
   Error Subcode MUST be set to Unacceptable Hold Time.  An
   implementation MUST reject Hold Time values of one or two seconds.
   An implementation MAY reject any proposed Hold Time.  An
   implementation that accepts a Hold Time MUST use the negotiated value
   for the Hold Time.
requirements.condition: The implementation accepts an OPEN Hold Time.
requirements.required_behavior: MUST use the negotiated value for the Hold Time.
requirements.why_checkable: The accepted negotiation result can be compared with the timer value installed for the session.

requirements.quote:
If the BGP Identifier field of the OPEN message is syntactically
   incorrect, then the Error Subcode MUST be set to Bad BGP Identifier.
   Syntactic correctness means that the BGP Identifier field represents
   a valid unicast IP host address.
requirements.condition: The BGP Identifier field of the received OPEN message is syntactically incorrect.
requirements.required_behavior: MUST set the Error Subcode to Bad BGP Identifier.
requirements.why_checkable: The OPEN processing branch and generated NOTIFICATION can be checked with the specified input.

requirements.quote:
If the BGP Identifier field of the OPEN message is syntactically
   incorrect, then the Error Subcode MUST be set to Bad BGP Identifier.
   Syntactic correctness means that the BGP Identifier field represents
   a valid unicast IP host address.
requirements.condition: Checking the syntax of an OPEN BGP Identifier field.
requirements.required_behavior: Treat syntactic correctness as representing a valid unicast IP host address.
requirements.why_checkable: Identifier validation can be checked using valid host addresses and invalid or non-unicast addresses.

requirements.quote:
If one of the Optional Parameters in the OPEN message is not
   recognized, then the Error Subcode MUST be set to Unsupported
   Optional Parameters.
requirements.condition: At least one Optional Parameter in the received OPEN message is not recognized.
requirements.required_behavior: MUST set the Error Subcode to Unsupported Optional Parameters.
requirements.why_checkable: The OPEN processing branch and generated NOTIFICATION can be checked with the specified input.

requirements.quote:
If one of the Optional Parameters in the OPEN message is recognized,
   but is malformed, then the Error Subcode MUST be set to 0
   (Unspecific).
requirements.condition: An Optional Parameter in the received OPEN message is recognized but malformed.
requirements.required_behavior: MUST set the Error Subcode to 0 (Unspecific).
requirements.why_checkable: The OPEN processing branch and generated NOTIFICATION can be checked with the specified input.
